answer.summary: The investigation focuses on identifying explicit, non-feature-based descriptions of latent behavioral drift or patterned response shifts in agent memory under stable, low-variation input conditions in Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1.
answer.content: This investigation seeks direct textual evidence from Kumar et al., 2024, Section 4.1 that describes latent behavioral drift or patterned response shifts as a memory mechanism in the absence of predefined feature vectors and stable input conditions. Acceptance criteria require at least one unambiguous, explicitly stated instance of such drift being described as a memory mechanism, not inferred or implied behavior. The inquiry remains bounded to primary-source, direct claims to preserve fidelity and avoid speculative interpretation.
